translations.web: Then they will know that I am Yahweh, when I have made the land a desolation and an astonishment, because of all their abominations which they have committed.” ’
translations.bsb: Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have made the land a desolate waste because of all the abominations they have committed.’
translations.kjv: Then shall they know that I am the LORD, when I have laid the land most desolate because of all their abominations which they have committed.
translations.asv: Then shall they know that I am Jehovah, when I have made the land a desolation and an astonishment, because of all their abominations which they have committed.
